mentions.name: wireplug
mentions.description: This tool creates mesh VPNs using standard WireGuard. Existing wg config files stay almost the same except peers no longer need a manually specified Endpoint: wireplug detects all possible endpoints (including LAN), coordinates them with peers, and handles NAT traversal, working with the in-kernel WireGuard driver on Linux and OpenBSD. Users keep managing their own keys and network topology while maintaining connectivity when moving between networks. Work in progress includes improving NAT traversal by adding PCP and NAT-PMP support.
mentions.problem: Manually specifying and maintaining peer Endpoints in WireGuard configs and keeping connectivity when moving between networks.
mentions.source_excerpt:
wireplug lets you create mesh VPNs using standard WireGuard.
Your wg config files stay almost the same, except you no longer have to specify an `Endpoint` for your peers.
Instead, wireplug detects all your possible endpoints (including LAN) and coordinates them with your peers for you.
It handles NAT traversal and works with the in-kernel WireGuard driver on Linux and OpenBSD.

mentions.name: WirePlug
mentions.description: A free and open source connectivity coordinator for WireGuard that keeps WireGuard tunnels connected while moving between different access points. It handles basic NAT traversal and works with the in-kernel WireGuard driver on Linux and OpenBSD.
mentions.problem: WireGuard tunnels drop connectivity when moving between different access points.
